item.title: Clothes Storage With No Closet: Measure First, Then Pick
item.description: A bedroom with no closet tempts people to shop first and measure never. A rolling rack arrives, a dresser follows, and the room ends up with two pieces that do not quite hold the wardrobe, or that hold it and block the way to the bed. This guide reverses the order. You will measure your clothes, add up how much hanging rod and drawer space they need, and only then choose the furniture.
